fields.title: What It Protects Against
fields.inputs/3/label: Lost laptop with a data copy
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each threat, note whether encryption in transit, at rest, both, or neither helps.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Wi-Fi interception in a cafe 2. Backup theft 3. Compromised database admin password 4. Lost laptop with a data copy 5. Bug in API permission checks
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — in transit. 2 — at rest. 3 — neither: access is legitimate from the system's perspective. 4 — at rest, if the laptop disk is encrypted. 5 — neither, this is an authorization bug. Takeaway: encryption covers two narrow classes of threats and does not replace access control.
